# CORE-TRC-04

**Is every functional scenario tied to a use case, and does every use case the design serves have a scenario?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | TRC: Place on the continuum |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `scenarios.use_case`, `context.serves` |

## Rule

Every scenario of type functional has use_case; every id in context.serves appears as the use_case of at least one scenario.
